name: Cancer Chemical Biology PhD (Moffitt)
detailsNote: Official annual admission and current undated funding information available; Fall 2027 dates and future stipend amounts not confirmed. Shared Moffitt admissions, distinct named PhD majors; admission model unconfirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall complete application
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual priority; all letters/materials must arrive by this date.

applicationFee.note: Central graduate page permits financial-hardship waiver requests; international eligibility must be confirmed. Some departmental pages restrict waivers to named affiliated programs; department cannot waive directly.

english.note: Central scores valid within 2 years of entry; PTE 53, TOEFL Essentials 8.5 and other alternatives listed. Country-language and qualifying US degree/coursework exemptions may apply; confirm with program. No blanket English-medium exemption inferred.

requirements.note: Bachelor degree with extensive biology/chemistry background; GPA 3 for full consideration. Research experience favored. Unofficial transcripts accepted for review; official records after admission. Program-specific selection should be confirmed when applying.

funding.note: All students tuition/fees/health; current first year $33,000 plus $4,000 arrival bonus, second $37,000, third and later $39,000 after qualifying exams. Undated rates, not a 2027 guarantee. Outside employment prohibited.
